author: NASASpaceflight
description:
The Space Coast is changing faster than ever.

This month we tour the latest construction at Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral, where SpaceX is rapidly expanding Starship infrastructure while Blue Origin begins rebuilding Launch Complex 36 following the New Glenn explosion.

In this update we visit Roberts Road, the massive new Starship Gigabay, Launch Complex 39A, Space Launch Complex 37, Blue Origin's launch sites, Stoke Space, Relativity Space, ULA, NASA's Artemis facilities, and much more as Florida prepares for a new era of launch activity.

🚀 In this episode:
• Starship Gigabay construction
• SLC-37 tower stacking
• LC-39A Starship progress
• Roberts Road expansion
• Blue Origin LC-36 rebuild
• New Glenn updates
• Stoke Space LC-14
• Relativity Space LC-16
• ULA Vulcan
• Artemis III preparations
• Port Canaveral developments

Whether you're following Starship, New Glenn, Artemis, or the future of commercial spaceflight, this is your complete aerial tour of everything happe
title: 🚀 Florida's Space Race is Heating Up | Space Coast Update
